steps.deviation_smoke_only: ml/books/data.py load_scores asserts a finite score on every base row, and a two-fold run scores 2 of the 103 fold months, so ab_books on the tag with --data ml/data_10y_liq* stops (685,897 rows without a score). The smoke therefore pointed --data at a scratch folder holding a symbolic link to the set's model_dataset.parquet and a splits.json cut to the two smoke folds, with ab_books' own --folds-only hook (no holdout rows). The full runs use the real dataset folder and splits; nothing in ab_books or ml/books was changed.
